new:
For Managed Local campaign measurement, ADR 0156 makes the `agent_harness` lane an explicit user-visible harness choice. Goose ACP Agent Harness is the normal/recommended Managed Local choice and freezes a provider-neutral runtime identity before execution. Legacy Native remains available only as an explicit compatibility/comparison selection and retains the historical missing-runtime identity; an ACP-selected run must never silently execute Native. The frozen ACP identity follows the campaign through experiment/child execution and must match the negotiated session identity before a schema-v4 ACP record can be written.

`read_question_v1` and `visual_evaluation_v1` are not currently admissible as common-ACP Agent Harness evidence: the first is defined by the Native provenance harness and the second requires host-captured image content beyond the current common ACP session contract. Rejecting those tasks is preferable to recording Native answers or unobserved images as ACP evidence.

Model-internal telemetry exposed only below an ACP agent remains truthful: model turns, prompt tokens, and response tokens are `Unavailable` when the adapter cannot observe them. GameEngine MUST NOT infer those values from ACP prompt boundaries, session events, or normalized Agent Host progress. The legacy native AgentRun path keeps its existing recorded-exchange semantics so historical records retain their original meaning.
